subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: After the concrete session and Approvals defects are repaired, should OpenClaw adopt this sidebar-only iPhone root navigation and native Overview absorption as the supported product direction?
rationale: The patch deliberately removes the existing tab-bar/Control-hub model and changes the iPhone information architecture; the protected maintainer label and broad user-facing replacement require an explicit owner decision beyond code correctness.

options.title: Approve the sidebar direction after repairs
options.body: Keep the sidebar-only shell, but land only after the session completeness and Approvals remediation defects are fixed.

options.title: Retain a tab-bar fallback
options.body: Keep the current navigation model for phone layouts and land only reusable sidebar/session components separately.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Defer the root-navigation replacement until the iOS product direction is documented and explicitly sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve the sidebar direction after repairs
recommendation.body: Keep the sidebar-only shell, but land only after the session completeness and Approvals remediation defects are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: The related navigation and Overview product-direction work and the current iOS redesign are both attributed to this contributor.
